partner_result.applied_scope: subcritical theta=1/2 localization/rearrangement bound and lossless arbitrary-support localization

mathematical_change.statement: For independent cap-one X,Y,Z and arbitrary affine terms, p_{2aXY+cZ^2+affine} has L-infinity norm at most (50+800 sqrt(2))^(1/3)|a|^(-2/3)|c|^(-1/3). The same holds conditionally for any full matrix with original-coordinate principal block [[0,a,0],[a,0,0],[0,0,c]], regardless of outside couplings.
mathematical_change.key_module: density(XY) has a uniform L3 bound obtained from the subcritical half-moment; density(Z^2) has a uniform L3/2 bound; Young closes the sum.

unresolved_implication: Extend the L3-L3/2 mechanism to a larger original-coordinate indefinite block class without shearing away independence, or combine the proved branch with a valid exhaustive matrix decomposition. Full three-large-eigenvalue target remains open.
